1. (Currently Amended) A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, and an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member, __wherein said lamp is configured to emit light in a pattern substantially different from a standard incandescent A19 lamp__.

2. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein a second end of said columnar body is open __and said open second end is not covered by any opaque material__.

3. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 further including a light dispersing optic element overlapping said diodes __and positioned to direct light in a controlled manner__.

4. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element includes a phosphor material __that converts at least a portion of light from said diodes to a different wavelength__.

5. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said diodes are substantially evenly spaced radially around the columnar body __and each diode is individually addressable__.

6. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 5 wherein said fins are substantially equally disposed between said diodes __such that each fin is positioned equidistant from adjacent diodes__.

7. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body comprises one of a tetragon, pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, nonagon, decagon, hendecagon, or dodecagon in cross-section __and has a length-to-width ratio greater than 3:1__.

8. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 7 wherein at least one diode resides on each face of said columnar body __and said diodes are mounted flush with the surface of said body__.

9. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 8 wherein one fin resides on each corner of said columnar body __and each fin extends radially outward by a distance greater than 2 millimeters__.

10. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 9 wherein a single diode resides on each face __and said single diode on each face is positioned at the center of that face__.

11. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body and said fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK __and said material is selected from copper, aluminum alloys, or composite materials with embedded thermal conductors__.

12. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 9 including a single optic element disposed between each adjacent fin overlapping said diode __wherein each optic element is individually molded to the specific geometry of its corresponding diode__.

13. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said base member comprises an Edison screw base or a wedge base __and includes integrated thermal management features__.

14. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said electronics module comprises a printed circuit board including circuitry for converting AC to DC current __and further includes dimming control circuitry__.

15. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element preferentially directs light substantially perpendicular to an elongated axis of the columnar body __and concentrates at least 70% of emitted light within a cone angle of 120 degrees__.

16. (Currently Amended) A lamp comprising an elongated hollow polygonal body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, a fin extending radially from each corner of said body, a light emitting diode mounted to each side of said body, a screw or wedge base connector closing a first end of said body, a second end of said body being open, an electronics module disposed within said body in electrical communication with said connector and said light emitting diodes, said lamp having a general A19 outline, __wherein the diodes are configured to produce a light distribution pattern that differs from a standard incandescent bulb by at least 20% in intensity distribution__.

17. (Currently Amended) A method of manufacturing a lamp comprising extruding an elongated hollow body, said body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, cutting said body to a predetermined length, attaching at least one light emitting diode to said body and providing electrical circuitry suitable for powering said light emitting diode, __wherein the extruded body includes integral fins formed during the extrusion process__.

18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said material has a thermal conductivity greater than about 150 W/mK __and is selected from aluminum alloys with thermal conductivity of at least 180 W/mK__.

19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said body includes a plurality of integral radially extending fins __formed as part of the extrusion process without subsequent machining__.

20. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 19 wherein said body has substantially straight side walls __and the fins are formed at regular angular intervals around the body__.
